name: Ortto
description: Ortto is a customer data and marketing automation platform for people, accounts, audiences, activities, reports, email, and push engagement.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated custom API key and exact default/Australia/Europe region enum. Relay pins 19 v1 operations: seven structural reads run directly, while five customer/report reads and seven bounded mutations require approval; audience opt-ins additionally require explicit recorded consent attestation.

credentialRequirements.name: ORTTO_CUSTOM_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Ortto custom API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-owned custom API key for the exact Ortto account and Relay application.

credentialRequirements.name: ORTTO_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: Ortto account region
credentialRequirements.helpText: Set to default, au, or eu; Relay maps this enum to Ortto's fixed regional API origin.

capabilities.label: Read CDP structure
capabilities.description: Use seven bounded schema, audience, field, tag, campaign-calendar, and report-list reads.

capabilities.label: Read customer and report data
capabilities.description: Use five bounded people, account, subscription, campaign-report, and saved-report reads with approval.

capabilities.label: Manage CDP engagement
capabilities.description: Use seven bounded record, audience, activity, email, and push mutations with approval.

allowed.label: Read Ortto structure
allowed.description: Read bounded schema, audiences, custom fields, tags, campaign calendar, and report-list metadata.

approvalRequired.label: Read Ortto customer and report data
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded people, accounts, subscriptions, campaign reports, and saved reports.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Ortto engagement
approvalRequired.description: Merge bounded records, update attested audience permissions, create activities, and send transactional email or push.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Custom API keys, authorization headers, secrets, and credential-bearing URLs never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Delete or administer Ortto data
blocked.description: Archive, restore, delete, suppression, identity, schema-definition, API-key, and integration administration are excluded.

blocked.label: Export or attach bulk data
blocked.description: Campaign exports, files, attachments, unbounded pagination, arbitrary Talk messages, and bulk transfers are excluded.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only 19 pinned v1 operations run on the selected fixed regional origin; arbitrary routes, origins, headers, and oversized requests are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Seven structural reads run directly; five customer/report reads and all seven mutations require approval, with explicit consent attestation for opt-ins.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 19 selected operations run without Relay per-action approval; fixed regional routing, bounds, audits, consent attestation, and secret/destructive/export blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts bounded Ortto tools, injects the encrypted custom key, and maps the stored region enum to a fixed v1 origin.
Railway mounts bounded Ortto tools, injects the encrypted custom key, and maps the stored region enum to a fixed v1 origin.

providerSetup.blocker: Ortto requires a customer-owned account, dedicated custom API key, exact region, and provider-side sender/push setup. No console, account, credential, consent, message, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Configure a dedicated staging key and default/au/eu region in Railway staging, then verify account binding, structural and sensitive reads, approval and consent-attestation denial/allow, record/activity writes, email/push delivery, bounds, rate limits, key disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Ortto documents customer-owned custom API keys, per-application keys, configurable merge behavior, X-Api-Key authentication, and fixed default/Australia/Europe API origins.

Ortto's current API reference enumerates the selected schema, people, accounts, audiences, activities, campaign, report, email, and push endpoints and destructive/export endpoints intentionally excluded.
Ortto documents the regional POST /v1/person/get resource and custom-key request model used for bounded sensitive reads.
Ortto documents the PUT audience subscription endpoint and its email and SMS permission mutations, which Relay approval-gates and requires consent attestation for opt-ins.
Ortto documents the regional transactional email endpoint, X-Api-Key header, request model, recipient batches, and attachment capability excluded by Relay.
